day.noActiveHabits: No active habits on this day. Use the pencil below to add one.

empty.title: No habits yet
empty.body: Create your first habit, then tick it every evening once you’ve kept it.

errors.unknown-format: This file isn’t a backup the app recognizes.
errors.negative-habit: “{{name}}” is a negative habit in Daygraph (ticked means failed), which isn’t supported.
errors.newer-version: This file comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app first.

import.title: Import data
import.mergeHint: Adds what’s missing. Nothing is removed.
import.replaceHint: Your current data is saved first, and can be restored from Settings.
import.replaceConfirmBody_one: Your {{count}} habit and {{checks}} ticked days will be replaced by this file’s content.
import.replaceConfirmBody_other: Your {{count}} habits and {{checks}} ticked days will be replaced by this file’s content.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Export creates a file you can save to Files or iCloud Drive. Import reads that file, or a Daygraph backup.
settings.restoreCopy: Restore data from before the last replace
settings.clearAllHint: Development only. A copy is saved first, and can be restored above.
settings.clearAllConfirmBody: All habits, ticks and filled-in days will be deleted. A copy is saved first.

habits.title: My habits
habits.intro: Drag a habit by its handle to change the order. Tap it to edit it.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Phrase it so that ticking it means success: “Don’t smoke” rather than “Smoke”.

archive.hint: It leaves the day screen and the statistics. Its history is kept, and you can restore it from Archived.
archive.confirmBody: You can restore it at any time.

archived.intro: Swipe a habit to the left to delete it for good.
archived.deleteBody: All its history will be erased. This can’t be undone.

habits.editHint: Opens the habit to edit it
